Title: Goodbye on the Desert Path

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the Magic English Voyage desert map. Warm cream daylight, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low saturation, gentle imperfect brush texture. Child-safe attractive faces: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles. Not glossy 3D, not plastic CGI, not neon, not hard vector.

Source Situation: Two young children have finished a short friendly moment at the desert oasis path. Now one child begins leaving along a side path while still facing the camera in a front-three-quarter pose. The other child stays near the oasis. They look at each other, smile softly, and use a farewell wave while saying "Goodbye." The meaning of "Goodbye" must be visually clear through separation, one child beginning to leave, the distance slowly increases, and both children waving farewell. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.

CEFR Target: Pre-A1 / very young A1. The target English expression is "Goodbye". The learner may not know any English. Keep every line short and natural. The expression "Goodbye" must sound like a real farewell, not a vocabulary drill.
